areas.name: Health (SUS)
areas.reason: Health-sector management efficiency platform and indicators, but about a quarter of resources and products aim at cost control, so little impact on expanding access to quality public health.

areas.name: Social security
areas.reason: Pension audit and planning system targets irregular payments and financial balance, with small funding; no link to extending coverage to all forms of work.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: Among the most affected areas: many objectives on people, planning, budget and procurement systems, about a third of resources and seven indicators; moderate potential impact.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: Several system modernisations, but about 10% of resources, few digital-transformation indicators and focus on internal management rather than citizens; very limited impact.

areas.name: Fiscal sustainability
areas.reason: Also among the most affected: systems, audits and process improvements with savings potential, about 30% of resources and several savings indicators; moderate impact.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: No components, products or indicators related to the area; two sub-products added in the new version have no funding and were deemed unrealisable.

areas.name: Transparency and participation
areas.reason: Transparency is a cross-cutting aim, but no components, objectives, products or indicators allow assessing results on the topic.

not_accepted.name: Sustainable cities
not_accepted.reason: No components, products or indicators related to the area; two sub-products added in the new version have no funding and were deemed unrealisable.
